ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, lines AB, CD, and EF intersect at point O. If $\angle COF = 120^\circ$ and $\angle AOD = 100^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOF$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle COF=120^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle COE=180^\circ-120^\circ=60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle DOF=\angle COE=60^\circ$,\\
and since $\angle AOD=100^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOF=\angle AOD-\angle DOF=100^\circ-60^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
